sig: [[["A", "Hi, this is Sarah from Marketing. I'd like to book a meeting room for a workshop next Tuesday."], ["B", "Sure. Is it a full day or a half day?"], ["A", "Just the morning, from nine to one. There'll be about twenty people."], ["B", "OK, let me check. Room 5B holds twenty-five, and it's free that morning. It's on the fifth floor, right next to the lifts."], ["A", "Perfect. Does it have a projector?"], ["B", "Yes, it does. But the microphone in that room isn't working right now."], ["A", "Oh. Could we borrow a portable one?"], ["B", "Sure, I can bring one up from the IT office on Monday afternoon."], ["A", "That'd be great. Also, we'll need two flip charts."], ["B", "No problem, there are a couple in the storage room. I'll send you a confirmation email in a few minutes, and just let me know if anything changes."]], {"A": "F-US", "B": "M-AU"}]
